decisions.reason: The instruction to begin contacting Airbnbs may imply proceeding with outreach, but it does not specify how to resolve the blocked template's prohibited platform names. The template value cannot be safely modified from this source.
The instruction not to inspect reviews applies to Airbnb host selection, not CJ Dropshipping product-review criteria.
The source concerns Airbnb outreach and lead entry, not the spreadsheet used to track commerce product listings.
The source's change to the lead inclusion criterion is already fully represented by the existing same-message MODIFY, with no obsolete keys or omitted updates.
Airbnb host selection does not change the completed CRM structure deliverable or its delivery destination.
The Airbnb selection instruction does not alter the task-local requirement to include deliverable links.
The source governs Airbnb selection and spreadsheet inclusion, but does not change when secured leads are entered into HubSpot or the data source used.
The source does not discuss Shopify publication, CJ Dropshipping, or website product-listing behavior.
The Airbnb host-selection change does not modify the Google Content Bank deliverable.
The reference to reviews concerns Airbnb host screening and does not affect Shopify product categories or categorization timing.
The source does not change daily social-media scheduling, publishing frequency, or the content source.
The Airbnb host-selection instruction does not alter the daily commerce product target or current product batch count.
